description: This file defines the LegacyGoogleSyncMigrationService class responsible for migrating user data and settings from a legacy Google Sync system to a newer CalendarSync system within SuiteCRM. It manages the migration process, interacts with multiple services, handles errors, and writes migration markers.

classes.name: LegacyGoogleSyncMigrationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for migrating legacy Google Sync user data, configurations, and meeting sync data into the newer CalendarSync system within SuiteCRM, including validation and progress tracking.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the migration service, sets up database and logger instances, and prepares the current user context.

methods.name: executeMigration
methods.description: Orchestrates the full migration process, including setting up prerequisites, migrating users, and creating migration markers. Returns status details.

methods.name: getProviderOrFail
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the external OAuth provider ID, or returns null if an error occurs.

methods.name: migrateSchedulerOrFail
methods.description: Migrates scheduler configurations, returning true if successful, false otherwise.

methods.name: findUsersOrFail
methods.description: Retrieves all legacy users eligible for migration, or null if an error occurs.

methods.name: migrateUsers
methods.description: Iterates through users and performs the individual user migration, including meeting sync data.

methods.name: writeMigrationMarkerFile
methods.description: Creates a marker file indicating migration completion for future checks.

methods.name: validateMigrationRequirements
methods.description: Validates system prerequisites for the migration, aggregating issues from all dependent services.
